newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio may seek partners for Benecol - CEO.
newsitem.headline: Raisio may seek partners for Benecol - CEO.

text.p: Finnish food, animal feeds and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy may look for partners to meet global demand for its Benecol margarine, and licenced producers are one option, CEO Matti Salminen said.

"Both (exports and overseas production) are possible but I think in the future we will have partners in this issue," Salminen told Reuters on Wednesday when asked whether Raisio was planning to export Benecol or to set up production units abroad.
"(Licenced producers) is indeed one option," he said.
Salminen could not say when Raisio's capacity would allow exports of cholesterol-reducing Benecol.
"At this stage it is difficult to say, and it largely depends on how much plant sterol will be available worldwide and what kind of investments are needed," he said.
Salminen said Raisio can meet domestic demand for Benecol once a new unit for processing the key ingredient plant sterol comes on stream in December.
